item.title: Seattle Fire, King County public safety agencies encrypt radio channels in mid-August
item.dc:creator: Kaila Lafferty
item.description: SEATTLE – Aug. 18, 2026 – Beginning Aug. 18, 2026, many King County law enforcement and fire agencies – including the Seattle Fire Department – are encrypting select radio channels to protect sensitive information, improve operational security and support responder safety.
